title: Nudge training TVBC
quote: The whole session was incredibly helpful, really practical information that we have already started to use in our work. I found it especially useful to use real work examples which allowed us to see very literally how we could apply the learning to the things we were working on. The whole session had a good atmosphere and really supported people to offer their ideas but also being challenged on what we already do, very valuable.
author: Hollie French
subject: Nudge
